mediation-vector.name: selection-identity
mediation-vector.description: The bio-formats/slf4j scenario: bio declares log:2 in its own POM (edge fact), but the site's resolved selection ships log:1 (the seed's constellation, as jgo managed mode resolves it). With a single site enabled, mediation is the identity on the selection -- the user gets exactly the release constellation, no warnings. Under edge-driven MVS, log:2 would have won.
